# cli { #keecas.cli }

`cli`

Command-line interface for Keecas configuration management.

Provides commands for managing global and local configuration files.

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get_version](#keecas.cli.get_version) | Get the current version of keecas. |
| [get_editor](#keecas.cli.get_editor) | Get the preferred text editor from environment variables. |
| [get_system_editor](#keecas.cli.get_system_editor) | Get the system default editor command for opening files. |
| [open_with_system_editor](#keecas.cli.open_with_system_editor) | Open a file with the system default editor. |
| [find_free_port](#keecas.cli.find_free_port) | Find a free port starting from start_port. |
| [get_templates_dir](#keecas.cli.get_templates_dir) | Get the templates directory path. |
| [generate_untitled_name](#keecas.cli.generate_untitled_name) | Generate an available untitled-N.ipynb filename. |
| [copy_template_to_workdir](#keecas.cli.copy_template_to_workdir) | Copy a template notebook to the working directory. |
| [check_jupyter_available](#keecas.cli.check_jupyter_available) | Check if Jupyter is available. |
| [check_jupyterlab_available](#keecas.cli.check_jupyterlab_available) | Check if JupyterLab is available. |
| [cmd_init](#keecas.cli.cmd_init) | Initialize a new configuration file. |
| [cmd_config_edit](#keecas.cli.cmd_config_edit) | Edit configuration file in the user's preferred editor. |
| [cmd_edit](#keecas.cli.cmd_edit) | Launch Jupyter server with keecas notebook templates. |
| [cmd_open](#keecas.cli.cmd_open) | Open configuration file with the system default editor. |
| [cmd_show](#keecas.cli.cmd_show) | Show current configuration. |
| [cmd_path](#keecas.cli.cmd_path) | Show path to configuration files. |
| [cmd_reset](#keecas.cli.cmd_reset) | Reset configuration to defaults. |
| [cmd_config_version](#keecas.cli.cmd_config_version) | Show configuration version information. |
| [cmd_migrate](#keecas.cli.cmd_migrate) | Manually trigger configuration migration. |
| [create_parser](#keecas.cli.create_parser) | Create and configure the argument parser. |
| [main](#keecas.cli.main) | Main CLI entry point. |

### get_version { #keecas.cli.get_version }

```python
get_version()
```

Get the current version of keecas.

### get_editor { #keecas.cli.get_editor }

```python
get_editor()
```

### get_system_editor { #keecas.cli.get_system_editor }

```python
get_system_editor()
```

Get the system default editor command for opening files.

### open_with_system_editor { #keecas.cli.open_with_system_editor }

```python

```

Open a file with the system default editor.

### find_free_port { #keecas.cli.find_free_port }

```python
find_free_port(start_port=8888, max_attempts=10)
```

Find a free port starting from start_port.

### get_templates_dir { #keecas.cli.get_templates_dir }

```python
get_templates_dir()
```

Get the templates directory path.

### generate_untitled_name { #keecas.cli.generate_untitled_name }

```python

```

Generate an available untitled-N.ipynb filename.

### copy_template_to_workdir { #keecas.cli.copy_template_to_workdir }

```python
copy_template_to_workdir(template_name, work_dir, target_filename=None)
```

Copy a template notebook to the working directory.
